final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT feecoin AS c1, AVG(rebtotal) AS c2, AVG((rebrate - feerate) / feerate) AS c3 FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS d1 FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c1 AS c1, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c2 - s2.d1 AS c4 FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.d1 IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.d1) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(c4) FROM s3
